description.en: Install the package and a compatible C++ compiler, check dependencies, and prepare an R session for TMB model fitting.
description.zh: 安装软件包与兼容的 C++ 编译器，检查依赖，并准备 TMB 模型拟合环境。

description.en: Learn how ACL and ALSCL represent population dynamics, growth, recruitment, fishing mortality and observation error, including the units of each time step.
description.zh: 理解 ACL 与 ALSCL 的种群动态、生长、补充、捕捞死亡率与观测误差，以及各时间步的单位。

description.en: Align the survey-number, mean-weight and maturity tables by length bin and time. Import Excel or CSV files and distinguish missing observations from genuine zeros.
description.zh: 按体长组和时间对齐调查数量、平均个体重量与成熟比例三张表。导入 Excel 或 CSV，并区分缺失观测与真实零值。

description.en: Fit run_acl() and run_alscl() to the bundled synthetic YTF example and learn the fitted objects, settings and data provenance.
description.zh: 对内置模拟 YTF 示例运行 run_acl() 与 run_alscl()，了解拟合对象、参数设置与数据来源。

description.en: Choose between simulate_example_data() for simple annual tables and initialize_params(), sim_cal() and sim_data() for full operating-model simulations.
description.zh: 选择 simulate_example_data() 生成简化年度表，或用 initialize_params()、sim_cal() 与 sim_data() 运行完整操作模型模拟。

description.en: Set starting values, bounds, fixed parameters, time steps and successive optimization passes for run_acl() and run_alscl().
description.zh: 为 run_acl() 与 run_alscl() 设置初值、边界、固定参数、时间步和连续优化轮数。

description.en: How fits use several cores for standard errors, how much faster they become, how to check and record the settings, and when to use the TMBad option.
description.zh: 拟合如何用多个核计算标准误、能快多少、怎样检查和记录设置，以及何时使用 TMBad 选项。

description.en: Use diagnose_model() and diagnostic_metrics() to inspect optimization, gradients, the Hessian, boundaries and residual patterns before interpreting estimates.
description.zh: 使用 diagnose_model() 与 diagnostic_metrics() 检查优化、梯度、Hessian、参数边界和残差，再解释估计结果。

description.en: Plot survey numbers, abundance, biomass, spawning biomass, recruitment and catch with the population plotting functions.
description.zh: 使用种群绘图函数展示调查数量、丰度、生物量、产卵生物量、补充量与捕获量。

description.en: Inspect growth curves, age–length probabilities, fishing mortality and residual structure using plot_VB(), plot_pla(), plot_fishing_mortality() and related plots.
description.zh: 用 plot_VB()、plot_pla()、plot_fishing_mortality() 等函数检查生长曲线、年龄—体长概率、捕捞死亡率与残差结构。

description.en: Use compare_models() and the plot_compare_*() functions to compare fitted quantities, observation fits and diagnostics on a common data window.
description.zh: 使用 compare_models() 与 plot_compare_*() 系列函数，在相同数据时间窗内比较估计指标、观测拟合与诊断。

description.en: Refit shortened series with retro_acl() or retro_alscl(), then visualize revisions with plot_retro() and interpret Mohn’s rho.
description.zh: 用 retro_acl() 或 retro_alscl() 拟合截短序列，以 plot_retro() 展示估计修订，并解释 Mohn rho。

description.en: Understand how annual flatfish and quarterly tuna presets differ in time steps, biology and operating-model structure. Both examples are simulated.
description.zh: 理解年度鲽鱼与季度金枪鱼预设在时间步、生物参数和操作模型结构上的差异。两组示例均为模拟数据。

description.en: Apply shared colors and themes with acl_theme_set(), refine ggplot objects, and export figures at an explicit size and resolution.
description.zh: 用 acl_theme_set() 设置统一配色与主题，调整 ggplot 图形，并按指定尺寸和分辨率导出。

description.en: Record assumptions, software versions and fit diagnostics; manage compilation caches and distinguish saved summaries from live TMB objects.
description.zh: 记录假设、软件版本与拟合诊断；管理编译缓存，并区分保存的汇总结果与当前会话中的 TMB 对象。

description.en: Review all scalar estimation keys, their optimizer-scale transformations, initial values and lower and upper bounds.
description.zh: 查阅全部标量估计参数、优化尺度变换、初值以及上下界。
